## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have added or updated tests that prove my fix is effective / my feature works
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally (`go test ./...`)
- [ ] `golangci-lint run` passes without new warnings
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / config examples where relevant
- [ ] This change does not leak secrets, API keys, or credentials
